name: pinpoint
description: Draw on anything. Screen annotation overlay for Linux.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --target node --format cjs --external electron --outdir dist && bun build src/overlay.ts src/shots.ts --target browser --outdir dist
scripts.install-app: bun run dist && mkdir -p ~/Applications && cp release/Pinpoint.AppImage ~/Applications/.Pinpoint.AppImage.new && mv -f ~/Applications/.Pinpoint.AppImage.new ~/Applications/Pinpoint.AppImage

author: Don

entry.Comment: Draw on anything. Screen annotation overlay.
